title: scorer/invoke route auth: POST scorer/invoke must be gated by validate_can_update_experiment, not the no-op validate_gateway_proxy
answers: Any authenticated user can run scorers on traces in experiments they cannot access via the scorer invoke endpoint. Why is that route not checking permissions?
How is the permission check for the POST /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke route configured?
Which validator protects the issues/invoke and genai/evaluate/invoke routes, and should scorer/invoke use the same one?
Where is authorization for the scorer invoke endpoint defined in the basic-auth app?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py route-to-validator map (the (INVOKE_SCORER, "POST") entry) decides who may call POST /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke, which takes experiment_id, serialized or registered scorer, and trace_ids to start scoring jobs that write assessments.
Rule: Map (INVOKE_SCORER, "POST") to validate_can_update_experiment, the same validator as the sibling INVOKE_ISSUE_DETECTION and INVOKE_GENAI_EVALUATE invoke routes, since these routes create runs in an experiment. Do not leave an invoke route on validate_gateway_proxy, which performs no experiment check.
Symptom: Any authenticated user could run scorers against, and write assessments to, traces in experiments they could not access (GHSA-6c27-cp6h-c66m).
Constraints: The route validator only checks UPDATE on the request's experiment_id and does not inspect trace_ids. A user who owns the experiment they name passes it, so trace ownership must also be checked in the handler (see the scorer trace-binding note). Applies to the basic-auth app route table.
applies: Auth route mapping for scorer/invoke in the basic-auth app; applies to any new invoke-style route that accepts trace_ids.
says: Users without edit permissions can still run scorers on traces in private experiments.
Restrict trace scoring so only members with experiment update access can launch evaluations.
Teammates can write score assessments into experiments they are not authorized to modify.
Block unauthorized users from triggering scorer jobs against restricted evaluation traces.
Anyone who logs in can evaluate traces in experiments they should not access.
search: In mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, route authorization for (INVOKE_SCORER, "POST") must map to validate_can_update_experiment instead of validate_gateway_proxy. This protects POST /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke, matching INVOKE_ISSUE_DETECTION and INVOKE_GENAI_EVALUATE, to ensure callers have update permissions on the requested experiment_id before creating runs and writing assessments. The route validator only checks UPDATE on experiment_id without inspecting trace_ids, leaving trace ownership checks to the handler. Applies to route mappings in the basic-auth app for invoke-style routes accepting trace_ids.
